account.changeEmailBody: We'll send a confirmation link t' th' new address. It only becomes yer sign-in email once ye follow that link.
account.emailChangeSent: Check yer new inbox fer a confirmation link.
account.handleHint: Letters, digits, “_” an' “-”. Must be unique.

appearance.customColourHint: Pick any color - buttons, highlights an' th' background tint follow it.

lastfm.desc: Scrobble yer plays t' Last.fm automatically.

data.body: Plunder everythin' Chordia stores about ye, or permanently scuttle yer account an' all its data.
data.deleteAccountConfirm: Permanently scuttle yer account an' everythin' in it, includin' yer listenin' history, charts, hoards, an' hearties? This cannot be undone.
data.deleteFailedBody: Could not scuttle yer account right now. Pray try again.
data.exportFailedBody: Could not export yer data right now. Pray try again.
data.title: Yer data

downloads.serverNote: Shanties hoards themselves be added an' organized on yer Chordia hoard server, not here. Stowin' booty t' a custom folder (wi' yer own path + organization layout) be comin' t' th' desktop app.

thisDevice.description: Plundered shanties be stored on this device an' play without a connection.
thisDevice.empty: Use th' Plunder action on any ditty or treasure.

downloads.title: Booty

autoplay.desc: Keep playin' similar shanties when th' muster ends.

crossfade.desc: Overlap an' blend th' end o' each ditty into th' next. Measured in seconds.

preload.desc: How many upcomin' muster ditties t' plunder ahead o' time, fer instant gap-free playback. Higher uses more data.
preload.label: Preload next ditties

activityVisibility.desc: Who can see yer recent plays an' compare taste wi' ye.
activityVisibility.label: Listenin' activity

emailNotifications.desc: Get an email fer matey requests an' other account activity.

followedArtistsVisibility.desc: Who can see th' artists ye follow.

followersVisibility.desc: Who can see th' accounts that follow ye.

followingVisibility.label: Followin' list
followingVisibility.desc: Who can see th' accounts ye follow.

activity.desc: What Chordia records as ye listen.

audience.desc: Who yer listenin' be visible t'.

openToFollows.desc: When off, nobody new can follow ye. Existin' followers stay.
openToFollows.label: Let scallywags follow me

playlistsVisibility.label: Charts
playlistsVisibility.desc: Who can see yer public charts on yer profile. Each chart still opts in separately.

profileVisibility.desc: Who can open yer profile at all. Everythin' below be only reachable once this lets someone through.

scrobble.desc: Record what ye play fer yer stats an' Rotation.

profile.bannerHint: A wide image across th' top o' yer profile.
profile.bioPlaceholder: A line or two about what ye listen t'.
profile.desc: What scallywags see when they open yer profile.
profile.linksHint: Up t' 8. Each must be a full https:// address.

timezone.description: Used t' place listenin' activity on yer local calendar. Follow this device leaves th' choice t' each client.
timezone.noMatches: No time zones match yer hunt

password.lockoutNote: Wrong attempts here count towards th' same limit as signin' in, so repeated misses will temporarily lock sign-in too.
password.revokeOthersDesc: Recommended if ye be changin' it because someone else may know it. This device stays signed in.
password.storedHint: Chordia only e'er stores a one-way hash o' yer watchword. Nobody, includin' us, can show it t' ye. If ye've forgotten it, reset it by email instead.
password.title: Watchword

setPassword.body: This account signs in wi' Discord. Set a watchword t' be able t' sign in wi' yer email address as well.
setPassword.needsVerifiedEmail: Verify yer email address first. Th' link t' set a watchword has t' go somewhere ye've confirmed ye own.
setPassword.sent: Check yer inbox fer a link t' set yer watchword.
setPassword.title: Set a watchword

sessions.body: Where ye be signed in. Revoke any device ye don't recognize.
sessions.signOutEverywhereConfirm: Sign out o' all devices? Ye'll need t' sign in again.

startup.desc: Where Chordia opens when ye sign in.

twoFactor.addHint: Add a second factor (an authenticator app) fer extra account security.
twoFactor.enabledHint: 2FA be enabled. T' turn it off, enter a current code or a recovery code.
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: 2FA be on. Stow these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each works once if ye lose yer authenticator.
twoFactor.scanHint: Scan this wi' yer authenticator app, then enter th' 6-digit code t' confirm.

verifyEmail.body: We sent a verification link t' yer email. Didn't get it? Resend it below.
verifyEmail.title: Verify yer email
